linked_issues.title: `reflex run --json`: the 30 s drain cap can end the stream mid-record, and a consumer that stops reading blocks shutdown forever

unresolved.first_comment: **Nested logs stop output** On supported Python 3.11, an oversized JSON record with roughly 600 nested containers can pass `json.loads` but fail inside `truncate_strings`. Each level adds both a function call and a comprehension frame, exhausting the allowed call depth sooner. The resulting `RecursionError` escapes `_write`, which only catches `OSError`, and stops the output thread. Later child output can fill the unread pipe and hang the command. Use a walk that does not recurse, or catch this failure and emit a bounded fallback record.
